findings.title: 24 June 2026: Google Search visibility ekdum giri
findings.detail: Same-length 7-day windows me Search clicks 5,541→665 (-88%), impressions 183,667→4,279 (-97.7%). GA4 views bhi 2,677→903 gire. Historical GA4 tracking incomplete tha, lekin GSC collapse asli hai. Cause abhi verify karna hai; /ai-control/research-june24.txt dekho. Google ka official spam update bhi 24 June ko shuru hua; ye strong clue hai, confirmed penalty nahi. GA4 hourly slowdown official start se pehle bhi dikhta hai.
findings.source: GA4 Data API + GSC Search Analytics API

findings.title: 6 Oct ke baad Analytics ke views achanak gire
findings.detail: Roz 230-330 views se seedha 37-92 par aa gaya, lekin Google Search ke click utne nahi gire. Shak hai ki 6 Oct wale consent wale badlav se ginna (measurement) kam hua hai — pehle saboot, phir badlav.

findings.title: Bio wala page poori site kheench raha hai
findings.detail: Bio copy-paste page par 28 din me sabse zyada views hain. Use aur mazboot karo, milte-julte bio pages ko usse jodo.

findings.title: Hinglish page Top-3 ke darwaze par hai
findings.detail: Position 6.5 ke aas-paas hai. Title/description aur andar ke link sudharne se upar ja sakta hai — naya article banane se sasta fayda.

findings.title: Kai bade pages ke title-description lambe hain
findings.detail: Tools, Guide, About aur Diwali page ke title Google me katke dikhte hain. Chhota aur saaf karne se click badh sakte hain.
